pages.text: Boss materials power magic. The Court presses three orbs of its own.
Eight $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/mobzilla)Mobzilla$() scales make Fire; eight $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/kraken)Kraken$() teeth make Ice. Both wrap a plain upgrade orb.
Eight $(l:orespawn_integrations:bestiary/water_dragon)Water Dragon$() scales press the third orb — pure mana, no elemental opinions.

pages.title: At the Anvil
pages.text: Apply an orb at Iron's Spellbooks' arcane anvil, onto any gear that accepts upgrades:$(p)Royal Fire Orb — +8% fire spell power.$(p)Royal Ice Orb — +8% ice spell power.$(p)Royal Mana Orb — +100 maximum mana.$(p)All three are epic-rarity and ride Iron's Spellbooks' own orb system as pure data — no custom machinery, no surprises.

pages.title: One Idea, Two Hats
pages.text: $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/spell_scrolls)Scrolls$() and orbs share one advancement branch because they're one idea wearing two hats: the Court's bosses teach the schools, and the Court's materials strengthen them.$(p)Note the currencies: these three run on Mobzilla, Kraken, and Water Dragon parts. Queen scales stay reserved for the $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/royal_dragon_egg)egg$() and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/court_economy)treasury$().
